Search and files
N3XRA Records helps organizations manage searchable files, public records, meeting documents, recordings, contacts, and secure team access without messy folders or hard-to-search archives.
N3XRA Records gives organizations a central library for files, generated documents, public records, meeting materials, recordings, contacts, and access controls.
Explore the interactive demo to see how searchable records, shared access, AI-assisted lookup, and public-facing delivery work together in practice.
The “3” in N3XRA points to the three parts of records management that usually break apart over time: storing records, finding them later, and turning them into useful workflows.
X · Facebook
Current Platform
N3XRA Records now supports searchable uploads, batch imports, public records publishing, library branding, contacts, templates, generated PDFs, meeting recordings, transcription workflows, and AI-assisted records lookup.
Add PDFs, DOCX files, text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, and HTML files. Selectable PDFs become searchable; scanned PDFs can be stored but need OCR before full text search or editing.
Search extracted text, titles, filenames, years, months, and saved AI notes when you need a specific meeting, packet, filing period, or topic.
Preview files, open source documents, download records, and generate PDFs from editable N3XRA documents and templates.
Keep internal access role-based while publishing selected records to a hosted public page or embedded view for your existing website.
Libraries can be shared with different permission levels, so billing, settings, file editing, contacts, templates, and read-only access stay separated.
Owns the library and controls billing, plan changes, and ownership-level decisions.
Manages shared access, invite codes, library settings, and day-to-day administration without owning billing.
Uploads, edits, deletes, downloads, shares files, and works with library documents without managing billing or ownership.
Gets read-only access to files with download and share access, without admin or editing controls.
N3XRA Records is built so organization files, editable documents, recordings, and contacts stay private by default, with access controlled by sign-in, library membership, and clearly assigned roles.
Private by default
Uploaded records belong to an organization library. Public records pages and embedded website views only show items marked public in libraries where public access is enabled.
Access control
Owners, account admins, editors, and viewers have different permissions, so everyday records work does not require handing out full account control.
Data boundary
Website embeds, public portals, and public file visibility are separate from internal libraries, giving organizations a clear path for sharing only the records meant to be shared

N3XRA Partner Programs
Effective date: July 22, 2026
Submitting an application does not create a partnership or guarantee approval. Participation begins only after N3XRA approves the applicant for a specific program. Applicants must provide accurate information, be legally able to enter this agreement, and provide any tax or payout information reasonably required before payment.
An approved website referral partner may earn a $100 commission for a qualifying referral. A referral qualifies only when all of the following are true:
A referral code does not by itself guarantee a commission. N3XRA's records determine attribution. If multiple partners claim the same client, N3XRA may review timestamps, submitted forms, existing sales records, and the client's information to determine the qualifying source. Self-referrals, referrals between accounts controlled by the same person or business, and retroactive claims are not eligible unless N3XRA approves them in writing.
Commissions are reviewed after all qualification requirements are satisfied. Approved commissions are generally scheduled for payment within 30 days after qualification and receipt of any required payout or tax information. Payment timing may be delayed for fraud review, payment disputes, incomplete information, legal compliance, or processor availability. Partners are responsible for their own taxes and reporting obligations.
No website referral commission is earned if the client cancels, fails to complete the required purchase, or receives a refund before the referral qualifies. If a qualifying client payment is later reversed, refunded, disputed, or charged back after a related commission has been paid, N3XRA may offset that amount against future partner balances after providing a record of the adjustment.
Approved partners may earn recurring commissions from qualifying referrals to participating N3XRA software products. Unless a product's written program terms state otherwise, the recurring commission rate is 20%, increases to 25% after the partner maintains 25 active qualifying referrals, and increases to 30% after the partner maintains 50 active qualifying referrals. Product-specific written terms determine eligibility, attribution, when a referral becomes active, how active referrals are measured, the commission period, payout timing and minimums, and the effect of cancellations or downgrades.
Approval for the website referral program does not automatically approve a partner for a software program. The flat $100 website referral commission is separate from software commissions and is not calculated using Commissionable Net Revenue. N3XRA Virals operates its own referral system and is not governed by these Partner Program Terms.
Software partner commissions are calculated from Commissionable Net Revenue , or “CNR.” CNR means qualifying customer revenue actually received by N3XRA for the applicable participating software product, less amounts directly connected to that customer revenue, including:

Change-of-control protections for applicable N3XRA software partner agreements.

N3XRA Partner Programs
Effective date: July 22, 2026
For purposes of this Agreement, a “Change of Control” means:
A financing transaction or minority investment that does not transfer majority control will not constitute a Change of Control.
All commissions earned from customer payments collected before the effective date of the Change of Control will remain payable under the ordinary payment schedule.
A successor may assume this Agreement by agreeing in writing to continue the Partner’s economic rights on materially equivalent terms. The successor may offer modified terms, but those modified terms will apply only if affirmatively accepted by the Partner in writing.
If the successor does not assume this Agreement on materially equivalent terms, future commissions will terminate on the effective date of the Change of Control. N3XRA will pay the Partner a one-time Change-of-Control Payment equal to six (6) times the Partner’s Average Monthly Commission.
“Average Monthly Commission” means the Partner’s total eligible commissions earned during the six (6) complete calendar months immediately preceding the Change of Control, divided by the number of complete calendar months included in that period.
For a Partner with fewer than six (6) complete calendar months of commission history, the calculation will use the complete calendar months available. A Partner must have at least one complete calendar month of eligible commission history to qualify for the Change-of-Control Payment.
The calculation will be based only on collected customer revenue and will exclude refunds, chargebacks, fraudulent transactions, unpaid amounts, delinquent accounts, canceled accounts, free accounts, and referrals that do not meet the Program’s eligibility requirements.
Commissions associated with prepaid recurring subscriptions will be allocated proportionately across the months covered by the customer payment. One-time service or project commissions will not be included unless the applicable Partner Plan expressly provides otherwise.
Any material reduction in commission rates or eligibility rules adopted after N3XRA enters into a signed letter of intent, exclusivity agreement, or definitive agreement relating to the Change of Control will be disregarded when calculating the Change-of-Control Payment, unless the change increases the Partner’s payment.
N3XRA will remain responsible for the Change-of-Control Payment unless the successor expressly assumes that obligation in writing. The payment will be made no later than thirty (30) days after completion of the Change of Control.
The obligations contained in this section will survive termination, expiration, assignment, or transfer of this Agreement.

N3XRA investment vision
N3XRA is building a connected technology company: practical services today, recurring software next, and a durable ownership platform for the future.
The long view
The opportunity is to build the company, the records, and the governance together—so future participation can be understandable, responsible, and worth joining.
Services, software, and useful products create the foundation for everything that follows.
If ownership opens later, rights, eligibility, and expectations should be documented from the beginning.
Every new layer would follow legal review, accounting, governance, and the needs of the business.
What it could become
Ownership would grow around the company—not get ahead of it. These are future possibilities, not active programs.
Employees and advisors may eventually receive properly documented ownership or equity-based arrangements with eligibility rules and vesting.
If N3XRA later accepts private investment, approved participants could receive defined rights through formal terms, review, and signed documents.
If the company becomes profitable and an authorized distribution is approved, payments could be calculated according to each interest’s documented rights. Nothing would be automatic or guaranteed.
Eligible participants may eventually request private purchases, sales, redemptions, or repurchases—subject to company approval, restrictions, and applicable law.
The ownership platform
The system would preserve the history behind ownership: decisions, documents, rights, valuations, vesting, issuances, transfers, cancellations, and payment history.
A possible future conversion
N3XRA is currently an LLC. It may eventually convert if a corporate structure better supports growth. Under an approved legal plan, the platform could preserve the complete LLC history while beginning a corporate record. No conversion has been promised or scheduled.
Nothing on this page constitutes an offer to sell, a solicitation to purchase, or financial, legal, or tax advice. N3XRA is not currently offering membership interests, shares, investment returns, distributions, or access to a trading marketplace. All concepts are preliminary, may change, and would only be introduced after appropriate legal, accounting, financial, tax, and governance review.

This Privacy Policy explains how N3XRA LLC, registered in Oregon and operating n3xra.com, collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use the N3XRA platform. N3XRA may include a shared account system, N3XRA Records, AI-assisted records search, meeting recording, transcription, speaker detection and optional speaker identification, phone and messaging features, AI Music Generator, N3XRA Virals, project pages, support forms, public or embedded views, and paid subscription features.
We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers that help operate n3xra.com, including hosting, database, authentication, storage, analytics, payment, email, telephone, messaging, support, AI, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, transcription, speaker processing, transcript extraction, and public metadata retrieval providers. For Records and Records AI features, document text or excerpts, file notes, library AI settings, saved AI memories, user questions, generated answers, usage data, recordings, transcripts, speaker information, meeting notes, templates, and drafts may be processed as needed to answer questions, create summaries or minutes, produce transcripts, identify speakers, highlight source material, and operate the feature. For AI Music Generator, prompts, lyrics, song titles, and generation settings may be sent to an AI music provider to create songs. For N3XRA Virals, source URLs, captions, public metadata, available transcripts, notes, product details, comparison inputs, and generated outputs may be processed by AI, transcript, hosting, or data retrieval providers to operate the analysis and comparison features. Information may also be shared when required by law or to protect the service, users, or legal rights.
Mobile information will not be sold, rented, or shared with third parties or affiliates for their own marketing or promotional purposes. Text-messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with third parties for their own marketing or promotional purposes. We may use service providers, such as telecommunications and infrastructure providers, only as necessary to deliver and support the messages you requested, maintain security, prevent abuse, or comply with law.
Content you or your library administrators mark as public or publish through embedded views may be visible to others. Shared libraries and role-based access also allow authorized users within a library to view or manage content according to their assigned permissions.
Library administrators may configure Records AI settings, saved AI memories, and file-level AI notes for a library. Those settings may be used to guide future Records AI answers for authorized users with access to that library.
An authorized account administrator may invite another organization to accept a record packet containing a meeting recording, transcript, notes, references, and generated documents. If the recipient accepts, copies are made for the recipient organization, ownership of the packet changes, and existing public share links for that packet are revoked. Administrators are responsible for confirming that a transfer is authorized and addressed to the correct recipient.
Customer content is not available to N3XRA support through ordinary support tools. An authorized customer may explicitly grant scoped, temporary support access. The grant identifies what support may access, expires after 24 hours unless revoked sooner, and is recorded in an audit trail.
Speaker detection can separate a meeting into generic labels such as “Speaker 1” without any voice profile. A voice profile is optional and is used only to try to replace a generic label with the enrolled user's name in future meeting transcripts. It is not used as a password, identity-verification method, or authentication factor.
Enrollment requires the signed-in user to provide affirmative consent and record their own voice. N3XRA sends that recording to pyannoteAI to create a mathematical voiceprint. N3XRA stores the resulting voiceprint on protected server systems and does not place it in the meeting result or expose it to organization administrators. N3XRA does not retain the raw enrollment recording in its own storage after enrollment. pyannoteAI temporarily processes enrollment and meeting audio and applies its published deletion schedule to media, job output, and worker copies.
Meeting audio may be sent to Groq for transcription and to pyannoteAI for speaker detection and, when eligible profiles exist, speaker identification. Stored results may include timestamps, utterances, generic speaker labels, matched names, and confidence information. Matches can be incorrect. Authorized users may play a short section from the existing meeting recording to review a speaker and may correct a label throughout that meeting; this playback does not create a new voiceprint.
You may revoke your voice profile from Voice Profiles. Revocation deletes the active voiceprint from N3XRA and prevents it from being used for future matching. Revocation does not automatically remove your name from transcripts processed earlier; authorized users may correct or delete those meeting records separately.
AI Music prompts, lyrics, titles, generated audio links, and saved song history may be stored with your account when you are signed in. If you use free songs without signing in, the browser may store usage information locally and completed songs may not be tied to an account. Generated audio links may depend on third-party provider availability and may expire or become unavailable.
N3XRA Virals may process user-submitted URLs, transcripts, notes, product details, captions, and available public video metadata to produce framework analysis, comparison results, hooks, scripts, captions, CTAs, and posting ideas. In the prototype experience, saved frameworks may be stored locally in your browser. If account-connected saving, team libraries, or subscriptions are added, saved framework data may be stored with your account or organization.
We retain information for as long as needed to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, maintain security, and operate app-specific dashboards. Meeting recordings, transcripts, speaker results, notes, and documents generally remain until an authorized user deletes them or the applicable account or organization is deleted. Browser recovery chunks for interrupted recordings are temporary and are scheduled to expire after 30 days. An active voiceprint is retained while the voice profile remains enrolled and is deleted when the user revokes the profile, the account is deleted, the purpose is satisfied, or deletion is otherwise required by law.
Reviews may retain snapshot details after an account, profile, or library is removed so the review can remain associated with the service. If you delete content or close an account, some information may remain in backups, security logs, provider systems, or legally required records for a limited period before deletion or isolation.
We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect information. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
N3XRA sends low-volume transactional SMS messages only after explicit consent. Messages may include requested links, account or security notices, appointment reminders, meeting or records notifications, support responses, and requested inquiry follow-ups. Message frequency varies according to your activity and requests. Message and data rates may apply.
You may reply STOP to opt out at any time or HELP for assistance. Opting out of SMS does not prevent you from using N3XRA through the website, email, or telephone, and consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of purchase.
The service is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us so we can review and delete it where appropriate.
